name: OrderProcessing
description: Workflow for Order entity handling create, update, and cancel transitions.

states.name: new
states.description: Order has been created but not yet processed.

states.name: active
states.description: Order is active and being processed.

transitions.name: create
transitions.description: Create a new order. Initializes order with 'new' state and required fields.

transitions.name: update
transitions.description: Update order details. Moves order to 'active' state if not cancelled.

transitions.name: cancel
transitions.description: Cancel an existing order. Moves order to 'cancelled' state.
